primary: B0 fixed-nominal y0 measure, corrected local Gaussian surrogate A_corr
selection_reason: continuity of nominal measurement/floor definition and transparent normalization; chosen before viewing new fixed-point totals; not ranking preference
held_fixed: nominal y0 and measurement e0 (equivalently fixed nominal projected velocities/errors)
Upsilon, acceleration scale, q, NFW M200 and prescribed c(M), H0
frozen masks and seven original model parameter layouts
uncertainty: independent Gaussian kernels centered D0/i0 with reported sigmaD Mpc and sigmai converted degrees->radians; independence assumed, not measured
physical_prior: D>0, 0<i<pi/2; normalized by Phi upper-Phi lower for each axis; endpoints have measure zero; no cos(i) prior
explicit_numerical_prior: finite tail T=3,4,5 intersects physical domain, each truncation normalized separately; T5 primary numerical approximation to physical-only prior; retain convergence/tail residuals
linearized_C: diag(e0^2+sigma_sys^2)+sigmaD^2 JD JD^T+sigmai_rad^2 Ji Ji^T; JD=dmu/dD; Ji=vm0*cot(i0)
linearization_caveat: uses nominal Gaussian widths and center: a normalized Gaussian surrogate, not exact marginal of physical/tail truncated prior; matched-linear-integrand quadrature isolates nonlinear from truncation errors
residual_derivatives: r0=y0-mu0; derivative residual=-mean derivative in fixed y0 coordinates
measure: density with respect to product of nominal velocity dy0 in km/s; full n log(2pi), logdet, quadratic; candidate deprojection density includes |a|^n Jacobian when converted back
B1_role: documented nonlinear explicit sensitivity; no invented B1 Gaussian reduction selected as primary
unsupported: global approximation validity near inclination boundary
